technology_partners.title: Technology Partners
technology_partners.description: Strategic technology partnerships that enhance our robot capabilities and expand our ecosystem.

partners.name: NVIDIA
partners.description: NVIDIA provides the GPU computing platform (Jetson Orin) that powers our Chikku Core ECU and on-device AI inference. We are an NVIDIA Preferred Partner for robotics.
partners.collaboration: Co-development of optimized AI models for Jetson platform. Early access to next-generation edge AI hardware.

partners.name: AWS (Amazon Web Services)
partners.description: AWS hosts our Chikku Cloud fleet management platform. Provides scalable compute, storage, and ML training infrastructure.
partners.collaboration: AWS Robotics Competency Partner. Joint go-to-market for manufacturing and logistics customers.

partners.name: Qualcomm
partners.description: Qualcomm 5G modules enable ultra-reliable low-latency communication for our autonomous vehicles and remote teleoperation.
partners.collaboration: 5G-enabled robot connectivity. On-device AI acceleration using Snapdragon platforms.
